cardEffects:
While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] While you have 1 or more memory, none of your [DS] trait Digimon can be deleted in battle.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.

name: Deep Savers

rulings.question: Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.
rulings.question: Can I also activate this card’s [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

rulings.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.
rulings.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?

rulings.answer: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed.  Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
rulings.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

rulings.answer: The check is performed with the card left revealed.  Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
rulings.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

rulings.answer: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.  After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
rulings.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

rulings.answer: Yes, it is not deleted.  This card's [All Turns] effect will activate as soon as you have 1 or more memory, therefore none of your Digimon with the [DS] trait will be deleted in battle.
rulings.question: I have this card placed face-up in my security stack.  An opponent's Digimon digivolved, and I now have 1 or more memory.  If my opponent's digivolved Digimon activates an effect and my Digimon with the [DS] trait attacks at such times, can this card's [All Turns] effect prevent my Digimon from being deleted in that battle?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon with the [DS] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
